name: Fountain Money
description: ⛲💰 punctuates wins and milestones. The combo reads as the louder alternative to a single 🎉. The read depends on context, but the register itself does not.
meaning: Used to mark a moment the sender wants punctuated with confetti. ⛲💰 shows up on big news — engagements, grad photos, new jobs, new houses. The read depends on context, but the register itself does not.

faqs.question: What does ⛲💰 mean from a coworker?
faqs.answer: From a coworker, ⛲💰 is team-coded celebration. The combo is a safe pick when something shipped, landed, or got signed off.

faqs.question: Does ⛲💰 have a hidden meaning?
faqs.answer: ⛲💰 rarely has hidden meaning. The celebration-coded cue is the read; any subtext has to come from the surrounding message.

faqs.question: What is the difference between ⛲💰 and ⛲💰 in a softer register?
faqs.answer: ⛲💰 is the celebration-coded "name" — louder and more emphatic. ⛲💰 in a softer register is a softer celebration reaction; reach for it when the moment is small.

faqs.question: Is ⛲💰 appropriate for work?
faqs.answer: ⛲💰 is appropriate for tight team channels. For wider org comms, swap to a single 🎉 or a sentence so the celebration-coded energy lands professional.
